recency_policy_days.basis: observed_at; labels age only, not confidence or importance

summary_statuses.unknown: No evidence recorded; must never be interpreted as zero ability or low interest.
summary_statuses.evidence_available: One or more records exist; no numeric signal score is generated.
summary_statuses.mixed: User-labelled supporting and challenging records both exist; preserve as an open question.

hard_rules: Every personal evidence record belongs to one student profile and preserves source kind, observed time, recorded time, uncertainty and capture-time consent metadata.
A profile under age 18 requires recorded guardian-consent confirmation; the MVP does not verify the person confirming consent.
Each repeated in-product behavior item requires its own explicit confirmation and non-empty activity_name/time_window context.
Repeated behavior must not be inferred from monitoring unrelated apps, websites or devices.
Challenge performance requires a challenge label, rubric name and criterion-level observation.
A numeric rubric score requires its own explicit score_scale; scores from different rubrics must not be normalized or compared by default.
Profile goal changes are timestamped ledger events; updating the current profile goal must not erase prior goal evidence.
No single unexplained ability, aptitude, personality or career-fit score may be calculated from the evidence ledger.
Users can correct stated information and permanently delete individual records, all evidence, or the whole profile and linked history.
The unauthenticated demo API must not be publicly deployed with real student or minor data.
Crossing the under-18/adult consent boundary with existing evidence requires deleting and recreating the profile; historic consent metadata must not be retrospectively relabelled.
Clearing all evidence also clears the mutable current goal and self-reported context, leaving only the empty profile/consent shell.
